SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Now then...
Time flies, looks like we arrived at the train station.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I wonder what kind of things people usually do on 
a normal date?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
I'm shocked. Don't you usually plan something 
ahead of time?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I mean, I did do some research on various things 
before coming here, just in case...

I looked up things like interesting movies and 
popular stores. However, will she really enjoy it if I 
take her to such places?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Good grief, it is what it is...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Don't say such things. Do you have anywhere you 
want to check out?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Let's see, for now...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: How about going to look at some clothes?

After visiting some clothing stores nearby the 
station, we took a break at a nearby cafe.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I'm surprised. So you do know some good shops.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Today is my first time coming here, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...You don't have to go through the trouble of saying 
things like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Even so, is this okay with you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: What are you referring to?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You didn't buy anything, after all that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...I can't buy such expensive things at a moment's 
notice.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Hey.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: How about I buy it for you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Eh? I-It's fine, really. I don't have a reason for you 
to buy it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You don't have to hold back, alright? I'd be happy 
to see you in various outfits.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Are you mistaking me for a dress-up doll?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, I'm not. Why would you say that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...It's because Senpai's given me nothing but 
presents.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hmm? Did I already give you a present?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [font_size=17]...The pen tablet.[/font_size]
Come of think of it, I guess that counts as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
And besides, I can make something like that on my 
own...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I see. That "Holy Angel Clothing" earlier today was 
made by you, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
That's right... Shall I make something for you as 
well?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Well, I think I'll pass on that.

Even if it's me, walking around in the streets 
cosplaying with my girlfriend is just embarrassing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Really? That's a shame...
Is that really such a shame, hey?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: In that case, I'll knit a sweater for you next time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Really!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You're surprisingly happy about this, aren't you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well of course!

I honestly thought getting a hand-knit sweater from 
your girlfriend was something like an urban legend.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Please do your best to look forward to it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's wrong?

It feels like Kuroneko's being fidgety for some 
reason...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...It's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You sure? You look a bit pale...
